How the neuron works

Charge is the positive part of volume surprise minus the size of the close-to-close move, with each input measured against its recent baseline. Charge adds to stock. Later moves release some of that stock in the direction of the move. A move of one recent range or more spends the entire available stock, and each portion can be spent only once. Each minute carries forward 7/8 of the unspent stock and 7/8 of the prior directional state. Tick exit adds four ReLUs that zero evidence within one tick and copy forecasts of two ticks or more. The selected model supplies the forecast in MNQ points. Stock, charge, and signed release are internal values.
